name: Kristin Russell
original_name: クリスティン・ラッセル
source: Kristin is a technician working in the Engineering section of the Moon Base D-02. Along with [url=https://vndb.org/c14809]Sergeant Jackie Kaminski[/url] he is one of the few men on the base. Ever since the sabotage of the base's operations had begun, he couldn't do his job properly so he seeks the assistance of the "[url=https://vndb.org/c14801]Technical Advisor[/url]". He hopes that the new guy will be able to restore the base's functionality to its full capacity.
